selection.help: The selected columns with their roles and the sheet they come from. The values stay in the worksheet.

suggestions.help: The charts that fit the roles, in rank order, each with title and note.

selectedChartType.help: The chosen chart, shown in the preview on the right.

openTarget.help: The module openInModule creates, or null when the chosen type exists only as a preview.

pickableColumns.help: The columns setColumns accepts, each { key, name }; the key is instanceId|sheetId|columnId.

columns.help: The chosen columns as references { instanceId, sheetId, columnId } into a data collection, all from the same sheet, each at most once. Empty until something is chosen.

pick.help: The chart type chosen by the user, or empty. It is shown while it is among the suggestions, otherwise the top-ranked one; the pick is kept across column changes.

preview.help: The preview of the chosen chart: kind single with widget and config, kind panels with layout, n, note and cells (composite preview), or kind none when the type has no preview.

read.help: Read the selected columns with their roles, the ranked suggestions, the chosen chart and the target module.

setColumns.help: Take columns of a worksheet as the selection; the ranking is rebuilt; the user's own pick is shown if it is among the suggestions, otherwise the top-ranked one. Roles come from the worksheet. Returns the suggestion types in rank order.

params.refs: A non-empty list of column references { instanceId, sheetId, columnId } from read().pickableColumns, all from the same sheet, each at most once.
params.command: The command as one object with refs.

pickChart.help: Choose one of the suggestions; the preview on the right shows the chart with the selected columns.

params.type: The chart type, one of the values in read().suggestions[].type. Any other value is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with type.

openInModule.help: Create the chosen chart as a module of its own with the same columns. If the type exists only as a preview, nothing is created.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

Selection.sourceInstanceId: The worksheet instance the columns come from.
Selection.columns: The selected columns in selection order, each with id, name, role and confirmation.

SelectedColumn.id: The column id in the sheet.
SelectedColumn.name: The display name of the column.
SelectedColumn.role: The role that drives the ranking: continuous, categorical, ordinal or date.
SelectedColumn.roleConfirmed: true when the role was set or confirmed in the worksheet, by hand or through its setColumnRole; false for an automatically detected role.

Suggestion.type: The chart type; the same value goes to pickChart.
Suggestion.title: The title of the suggestion in the active language.
Suggestion.notes: The note on the suggestion in the active language, or '' without one.

AgentRead.selection: The selected columns with their roles and the sheet they come from. The values stay in the worksheet.
AgentRead.suggestions: The charts that fit the roles, in rank order, each with title and note.
AgentRead.selectedChartType: The chosen chart, shown in the preview on the right.
AgentRead.openTarget: The module openInModule creates, or null when the chosen type exists only as a preview.
AgentRead.pickableColumns: The columns setColumns accepts, each { key, name }; the key is instanceId|sheetId|columnId.
AgentRead.preview: The chart data of the shown preview: one chart, a panel set or none.
